cases.requirement: Recognise the synthetic sandbox and truthful provider
steps: read the banner and provider label
switch between Sandbox and Live records
cases.expected_outcome: Sandbox names scripted-planner and a real Strands loop; live configuration is separately labelled
cases.negative_recovery_case: Blocked storage keeps the tab usable and displays a recovery note
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile sandbox and live labels; storage-blocked browser journey and storage recovery tests. cases.requirement: Add a food offer and obtain a reasoned allocation
steps: fill donor organisation, quantity, category, dates and allergens
cases.expected_outcome: Backend validates typed fields; durable offer is reviewable and real Strands scripted run produces reasons
cases.negative_recovery_case: Phone number or prompt instruction is refused with entered fields retained
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile human intake -> persisted offer after reload -> Strands split -> exact approval -> confirmed collection; invalid phone field retained and recoverable. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Consent binds the exact run, record address and digest
cases.preconditions: A finished run with passing gate
cases.expected_outcome: One synthetic record; public S3 is unchanged; collection remains unconfirmed
cases.negative_recovery_case: Stale digest, missing consent, duplicate approval and changed relevant sources are refused
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile exact-plan approval; API rejects missing consent, stale digest, duplicate approval and relevant evidence changes. Offline writer transport test confirms exact bytes and no overwrite; no live publication exercised. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Claim, schedule and confirm a share without double collection
cases.expected_outcome: Backend stores role and schedule; confirmation is explicit; refresh retains each stage
cases.negative_recovery_case: Unallocated organisation, free-text role, invalid time, expired commitment and second confirmation are refused
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile claim, reload, future schedule and explicit confirmation; API rejects invalid roles/times and duplicate confirmation. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

steps: Change relevant offer evidence in offline regression fixture
cases.expected_outcome: Old commitment shown invalidated; old record preserved and marked superseded
cases.negative_recovery_case: Adding an unrelated offer must leave the original commitment valid
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated API regression): relevant source change rejects old commitment; rerun invalidates it and preserves superseded record. Adding an unrelated offer leaves original pickup usable. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Distinguish overdue, claimed, scheduled, confirmed and invalidated states
cases.preconditions: Persisted pickup rows covering time transitions
cases.expected_outcome: Unconfirmed scheduled time in the past reads Overdue; allocated quantity never counts as collected
cases.negative_recovery_case: Confirmed facts do not age into unclaimed collections after 14 days
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): component status/filter coverage and persisted API overdue/expired transitions; confirmed facts remain confirmed after 14 days. Time transitions were fixture-driven, not a real elapsed-time study. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Share an accurate, PII-checked reasons summary
cases.expected_outcome: Names organisation allocations and exclusion reasons; draft/publication state is explicit; no message sent
cases.negative_recovery_case: Clipboard refusal leaves selectable text; personal-data output is withheld
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): summary content in real browser; clipboard success/refusal in component tests; exported personal data rejected by API. Actual sharing with another person NOT_RUN. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Unsafe cold-chain offers stop before approval
cases.expected_outcome: Safety refusal and its reason; no approval action
cases.negative_recovery_case: No model finding can clear the deterministic refusal
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile chilled-offer safety refusal, findings and absent approval action; existing model-cannot-clear-refusal regression suite passed. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Persistent navigation, search, empty and missing states
cases.expected_outcome: Hash navigation survives reload; no-match and missing states offer recovery
cases.negative_recovery_case: Expired session gives explicit new-session action rather than invented empty data
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): desktop/mobile deep links, reload, search and history; component missing-route and expired-session recovery. Legacy link URL/new-tab/noreferrer verified by component test, not followed to mutate live state. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

steps: Open live offer, add form, pickups and history
cases.expected_outcome: Live remains readable; changes require trusted network coordinator; sandbox remains separate
cases.negative_recovery_case: Forged body/header identity grants no rights; writer role alone cannot serve coordinator API
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): anonymous live read-only browser and API rejection of forged identity. Trusted-authorizer writer journey exercised through local handler transport only; deployed coordinator authentication NOT_RUN. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

cases.requirement: Recover safely without automatic repeated writes
steps: Cause a failed mutation in component test
cases.expected_outcome: Error is actionable; form fields/consent retained; same request id is reused for same inputs
cases.negative_recovery_case: 35-second timeout reports unknown outcome; backend pending action cannot execute twice
cases.observed_result_evidence: PASS (automated): timeout/cancellation and explicit retry request-id tests; failed consent/intake entries retained; persisted pending outcome rejects replay and new mutation. Evidence: https://github.com/upgradedev/merismos-aws/actions/runs/34327011203 (frontend-evidence artifact: test-results/*.xml, coverage/, Playwright traces/screenshots).

inspect focus, labels, reading order, zoom and contrast

verification.scope: Offline GitHub Actions: real Python HTTP handler and SQLite, real scripted Strands loop. No live AWS/model/email/publication action and no human acceptance signoff.

live_aws_verification.scope: CloudFront, Lambda and DynamoDB. Real scripted Strands; synthetic isolated offers, approvals and pickup confirmations. Live-mode mutation was refused by API with HTTP 403. No historical public record overwritten; human signoff NOT_RUN.
